info.description: 8.38B reranker that scores a text query against a document of text, a page image, or both. Context is 32,768 tokens. Weights use OpenMDW-1.1. The API reference dates both the Hugging Face card and the planned Build.NVIDIA listing to 2026-10-20. No request path is printed, and no numeric standard price is published.

zh.description: 8.38B 重排模型，对文本查询与文档（文本、页面图像或两者）的相关程度打分。上下文 32,768 tokens。权重使用 OpenMDW-1.1。API 参考把 Hugging Face 模型卡和计划中的 Build.NVIDIA 上架都写为 2026-10-20。页面没有给出请求路径，也没有数字标准价。
